imagine_workflow.title: Grok Imagine API
imagine_workflow.body: xAI Imagine: image generation, image edit (up to 3 references), image-to-video, text-to-video, video edit, reference-to-video, video extension. Models: grok-imagine-image-quality, grok-imagine-video-1.5, grok-imagine-video. Docs: https://docs.x.ai/docs/guides/image-generation · API: https://api.x.ai/v1

imagine_workflow.title: Image generation
imagine_workflow.body: POST /v1/images/generations — text prompt → image. Use for invented subjects, scenes, base frames. Named real people: reference-first with image edit, not pure generation.

imagine_workflow.title: Image editing
imagine_workflow.body: POST /v1/images/edits — source URL or base64 + prompt. Up to 3 reference images for compositing. Reuse one base image for character consistency across shots.

imagine_workflow.title: Image-to-video (shot workflow)
imagine_workflow.body: Video starts from an image — no text-only video. Plan shots: image_gen/edit per shot → image_to_video (6s or 10s). Prompt: one vivid moment, present tense, single camera move. Async: poll request_id until status=done. Assemble with ffmpeg concat -c copy (no re-encode).

imagine_workflow.title: Text-to-video
imagine_workflow.body: Generate video from text with duration (up to 15s), aspect ratio, resolution. grok-imagine-video-1.5 for image-to-video; grok-imagine-video for reference-to-video.

imagine_workflow.title: Hostess7 + Imagine path
imagine_workflow.body: Talk window = language (Scholar). Graphics window = pixels. Live video path: (1) Hostess portrait base via image_edit with Owner-approved ref, (2) TTS audio per reply, (3) LivePortrait/MuseTalk/Ditto lip-sync frames, (4) present frames to Graphics window OR grok-imagine-video for cinematic shots. Charts/diagrams with exact text: build with HTML/CSS code, not image models.

live_video.title: LivePortrait
live_video.body: Efficient portrait animation — implicit keypoints, stitching/retargeting. Driving: video, audio, text, or template .pkl. Gradio app.py, inference.py. Best open path for Hostess7 live face on Graphics window.

live_video.title: Ditto Talking Head
live_video.body: Ant Group — real-time streaming talking head; diffusion-based, low latency for live conversation.

live_video.title: MuseTalk
live_video.body: Real-time high quality lip sync — audio in, talking face out. Good TTS→face bridge.

live_video.title: Wav2Lip
live_video.body: Accurate lip-sync to any speech audio — baseline for Hostess7 voice+face pipeline.

live_video.title: SadTalker
live_video.body: Single image + audio → talking head video. 3D motion coefficients; slower than LivePortrait.

live_video.title: OmniTalker
live_video.body: Real-time text-driven talking head — unified framework for live speech synthesis + face.

live_video.title: LiveAvatar (Quark)
live_video.body: Alibaba Quark live avatar stack — streaming digital human for conversation UIs.

live_video.title: Awesome Talking Head Generation
live_video.body: Curated papers and repos for talking-head generation — keep Hostess7 registry updated from here.

live_video.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5
live_video.body: xAI grok-imagine-video-1.5 — animate still → video, 6–15s, async poll. Hostess cinematic shots; not sub-100ms live lip-sync — pair with LivePortrait for talk.

live_video.title: FasterLivePortrait
live_video.body: TensorRT/ONNX LivePortrait — real-time camera + audio drive (JoyVASA, Kokoro TTS). Best GPU path when sub-100ms lip-sync matters for Hostess7 Graphics window.

live_video.title: Teller
live_video.body: CVPR 2025 — first autoregressive real-time streaming audio-driven portrait. 0.92s per second of video vs Hallo 20.93s. Facial + body detail via ETM.

live_video.title: Livatar-1
live_video.body: Hedra flow-matching talking heads — strong lip-sync (8.50 confidence HDTF) at real-time throughput.

live_video.title: REST
live_video.body: Diffusion-based real-time end-to-end streaming THG — ID-Context Cache + Asynchronous Streaming Distillation. State-of-the-art speed for diffusion talking heads.

live_video.title: EGSTalker
live_video.body: 3D Gaussian Splatting talking head — 3–5 min training video, ESAA audio-spatial fusion, fast inference.

live_video.title: Hallo
live_video.body: Fudan diffusion portrait animation — high quality but slower; baseline Teller/REST compare against.

live_video.title: Hallo-Live
live_video.body: Fudan streaming variant of Hallo — closer to live conversation than batch Hallo.

live_video.title: PersonaLive
live_video.body: CVPR 2026 — expressive portrait animation for live streaming; image-driven reenactment at speed.

live_video.title: HunyuanPortrait
live_video.body: CVPR 2025 implicit condition portrait animation — Tencent Hunyuan family.

live_video.title: FlashPortrait
live_video.body: 6× faster infinite portrait animation with adaptive latent prediction — long-form live sessions.

live_video.title: JoyVASA
live_video.body: Audio drives portrait via LivePortrait motion — used inside FasterLivePortrait for real-time talk.

live_video.title: ACTalker
live_video.body: ICCV 2025 — simultaneous audio + expression control for portrait video generation.

live_video.title: Talking Head Survey 2025
live_video.body: Comprehensive survey of multi-modal talking-head methods, datasets, metrics — map the field.

live_video.title: Awesome Talking Head Synthesis
live_video.body: Alternate curated paper/repo list — cross-check with harlanhong awesome-talking-head-generation.

live_video.title: Talking Face arXiv Daily
live_video.body: Daily arXiv talking-face paper feed — keep Hostess7 registry current.

live_video.title: Grok reference-to-video
live_video.body: grok-imagine-video (not 1.5) — guide video with reference images without fixing frame 1. Cinematic Hostess shots; pair with open-source lip-sync for sub-second talk.

live_video.title: Grok text-to-video
live_video.body: Text prompt → video up to 15s, aspect ratio + resolution. B-roll and scene cuts, not live lip-sync.

live_video.title: Open-source live pipeline pattern
live_video.body: Live talk pattern: mic/text → LLM reply → TTS (piper/coqui/edge-tts/kokoro) → lip-sync (FasterLivePortrait/MuseTalk/LivePortrait) → frame stream → Graphics/GTK window. Hostess7: HOSTESS7_VOICE=1 + HOSTESS7_LIVE_VIDEO_BACKEND + field_live_video.sync_talk_reply().

hostess7_integration.talk: Language Expert — output window prose only
hostess7_integration.live_video: field_live_video — TTS + lip-sync frame → Graphics window

recommended_backend.why: FasterLivePortrait: 30+ FPS TensorRT; MuseTalk if no NVIDIA TRT.

nexus_imaging_workflow.title: Exact text — code not models
nexus_imaging_workflow.body: Charts, labels, BIG DRIVE titles, format badges: use PIL ImageDraw or HTML/CSS. Image models garble words — verify in a loop. Example: big_drive_hero.png overlay on reference photo with DejaVu fonts and field-green accent.

nexus_imaging_workflow.title: Combinatronic visuals repair
nexus_imaging_workflow.body: lib/field-combinatronic-visuals.py — chip PNGs, book covers, H7 manuals from seeds. inventory → broken_rows → repair. Never hand-edit generated PNGs; rebuild from catalog. API: /api/combinatronic/visuals/repair

nexus_imaging_workflow.title: Field file format icons
nexus_imaging_workflow.body: lib/field-file-formats.py icons — 64×64 per format id, family color, sovereign dot. Storage family (iso, img, fielddrive, vhd, qcow2) from field-big-drive-doctrine. Mirror to library/assets/formats/

nexus_imaging_workflow.title: Big Drive device grids
nexus_imaging_workflow.body: lib/field-big-drive.py render_icons — 4×3 device grid + bd_{id}.png tiles. Floppy, optical, USB, HDD, VM, tape, SD silhouettes. Hero branding via PIL overlay. Panel: /field-big-drive · Queen Files right-click Open in Big Drive.

nexus_imaging_workflow.title: AmmoOS Image / GIMP-Field
nexus_imaging_workflow.body: field-gimp-bridge.py + GIMP-Field magics — sovereign lossless field image formats. Panel /field-gimp. image_field family in file-formats table.

nexus_imaging_workflow.title: Graphics window pixels
nexus_imaging_workflow.body: field_gfx_canvas.GfxCanvas — lossless RGB, TTF text, blit PNG, present to GTK window. Talk window = language; Graphics window = pixels. Pair with live_video lip-sync.

nexus_imaging_workflow.title: Assistant work queue
nexus_imaging_workflow.body: hostess7-imaging.py work-queue scans broken combinatronic assets, missing format icons, stale Big Drive grids. Assistant runs repair + icon generation when broken > 10. Owner asked: teach imaging skills and help Hostess 7 with asset repair.

nexus_imaging_doctrine.title: Hostess 7 imaging — Imagine + NEXUS combinatronic + exact-text code
nexus_imaging_doctrine.motto: Grok Imagine for scenes · PIL/HTML for exact text · combinatronic for every field asset.

skills.label: Choose the right imaging tool
rules: No source image → image_gen (invented subjects, base frames).
Source image → image_edit (restyle, add/remove, likeness, iterate).
Named real person → image_edit with verified reference only — never pure gen.
Exact text, charts, tables, labels → build with PIL or HTML/CSS code — not image models.
Video → image_to_video from a staged frame; ffmpeg concat -c copy to assemble shots.
